summary: Regression tested date/uuid column type migrations (m016 focus_topics.created_at, m017 meetings.meeting_type_id -> uuid, m018 schedules.start_date + supervision_uploads.meeting_date -> date, m019 meetings.date -> timestamp) and the new DATE codec in database.py. Wrote pytest suite (12 tests, all passing) covering: (1) DB schema — 4 migrations recorded in schema_migrations, all 6 target columns typed correctly (evidence_feedback.evidence_item_id UNCHANGED as text as intended), fk_meetings_meeting_type_id exists with ON DELETE SET NULL, zero data loss on meetings.date (all 15+ non-null); (2) meetings write/read — datetime-local ('2026-09-10T14:30'), date-only ('2026-09-15'), and full-precision ('2026-10-01T09:15:30') all round-trip; meeting_type_id returns None cleanly; (3) schedules — GET returns plain 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings, POST + PUT with start_date persist and round-trip correctly (new DATE codec write path); (4) doc-uploads — POST with meeting_date persists as 'YYYY-MM-DD' via DATE codec; (5) team-insights + action-stats date filters return 200 on the new TIMESTAMP column. Frontend E2E: NewMeeting.js date+time picker successfully created a meeting (redirected to /meetings/{id}/prepare); API round-trip confirmed 'date': '2026-09-05T14:30:00' and 'meeting_type_id': null. Dashboard renders meeting dates correctly (e.g. '21 Aug 2026', '19 Aug 2026' — formatDate works on new TIMESTAMP values).
critical_code_review_comments: database.py:57-108 — _encode_date/_decode_date pair correctly mirrors the existing timestamp codec pattern. Note: _decode_date is a passthrough on the raw text output from asyncpg — verify asyncpg's DATE text codec actually returns 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings on all supported versions (works today; document the invariant in a docstring).

schedules.py:341-345 — POST validates start_date via date.fromisoformat but POST (schedules.py:293) does NOT — data.start_date is passed as raw str to the DATE column, relying on Postgres to reject bad strings with a 500. Consider mirroring the PUT validation on POST for consistent 422 errors on invalid input.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (UI meeting create -> API round-trip verified, Dashboard date formatting intact)
